summary: Tested the two changes from this session: (1) White/3-col ActivityListPage redesign at /activities/category/:slug and /activities/company/:slug - confirmed hero stays dark-teal, filter bar + card grid below turns white, Location/Duration dropdown filters open/close correctly and filter the visible cards with live 'N results' count updating, seller-name link is gray (not orange) and correctly navigates to the company page, seed 'Sunset Sail' card matches the reference exactly (black hourglass duration badge '4 HOURS' top-left, two-tier white/dark 'FROM $45' badge bottom-right, no seller logo overlay, black title, gray description, full-width dark-blue uppercase BOOK NOW button). Grid is lg:grid-cols-3 in code (only 1 seed activity exists so 3-across couldn't be visually confirmed with multiple cards, but class verified via source). (2) Booking funnel tracking - verified end-to-end via network interception + backend GET summary: on ActivityListPage, clicking Book Now for the generic/external activity correctly fires book_now_click + external_redirect (new tab opened via window.open works reliably). Temporarily switched Sunset Sail to booking_provider=fareharbor via API to test the drawer path on BOTH ActivityListPage and ActivityDetailPage: book_now_click + drawer_opened fired on open, drawer_closed with a real duration_seconds fired on Escape-close for both pages - reverted back to generic afterwards (confirmed via API, no residual test data left on the seed record). Admin /admin/tours-charters dashboard 'Booking Activity' widget renders all 4 stat boxes (Clicks/Opened/Redirects/Engaged 20s+) with live numbers that increased after my test clicks, a scrollable Recent Activity list, the correct disclaimer text about 'Engaged' being a proxy signal, and sits correctly alongside the unchanged 'Unpaid Invoices' panel. CRITICAL FINDING: on ActivityDetailPage, the generic-external-link Book Now button (plain <a target='_blank'> with fire-and-forget tracking in onClick) reproducibly failed to send ANY tracking request (0 requests even initiated) across 3 separate test attempts - the browser navigated away from/over the current page instead of reliably opening a new tab, cancelling the pending axios call before it could fire. This is DIFFERENT from ActivityListPage's identical generic-link scenario, which uses an explicit JS window.open() call in the click handler and reliably fired both events every time. Regression: Directory page (dark theme, 4-col grid unchanged), ActivityDetailPage renders fine dark-themed with tracking wired in, Charter Companies/Invoices/Dev Settings FareHarbor feature flags pages all load correctly with expected data, mobile viewport (390px) renders the new white list page/filter bar/card cleanly with proper wrapping. Backend: wrote new backend/tests/test_booking_events_tracking.py (11 tests) covering the new public POST + admin GET summary endpoints including auth guard, validation, and engaged-20s-threshold logic; ran full regression across all 5 tours-charters test files (80/80 passing).

integration_issues.flow: ActivityDetailPage Book Now tracking for generic external-link bookings
integration_issues.issue: trackExternalClick() is fired in the <a target='_blank'> onClick handler as a fire-and-forget axios.post() (not awaited, no preventDefault/manual navigation). In this test environment the click reproducibly caused the page to navigate away instead of reliably opening a genuine new tab, which cancelled the pending POST before it could be sent - resulting in ZERO booking-events network requests observed across 3 separate test attempts (confirmed via page.on('request') listener showing 0 requests even initiated, not just failed/cancelled-in-flight). This is inconsistent with ActivityListPage's handleBookNow for the identical generic-link case, which explicitly calls trackBookingEvent() then window.open(url,'_blank') as two separate synchronous JS calls in the click handler - that path fired both book_now_click and external_redirect reliably every time it was tested. Recommend making ActivityDetailPage's generic-link Book Now use the same pattern (e.preventDefault() + trackBookingEvent() + window.open()) instead of relying on the browser's native target=_blank anchor navigation, for consistent tracking regardless of popup-blocker/browser behavior.
integration_issues.priority: MEDIUM - only affects the generic-external-link path on the DETAIL page; the identical LIST page path and both pages' FareHarbor drawer paths (book_now_click/drawer_opened/drawer_closed) all fired correctly and reliably in every test

action_items: Fix ActivityDetailPage's generic-external-link Book Now tracking reliability: switch from relying on native <a target='_blank'> navigation to an explicit e.preventDefault() + trackBookingEvent() + window.open() pattern (mirroring ActivityListPage's handleBookNow), so the tracking POST reliably fires before/independent of the outbound navigation.

No other action items - white/3-col card redesign, dropdown filters, FareHarbor drawer tracking (list + detail), admin dashboard widget, and all spot-checked regressions (Charter Companies, Invoices, Dev Settings feature flags, Directory page, mobile responsiveness) are all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: activityMarketplaceShared.js trackBookingEvent(): correctly fire-and-forget (catches its own errors, never throws) so a tracking failure can never break the booking flow itself - good defensive pattern.

tours_charters_billing.py booking_events_summary(): duration-based 'engaged' filter (>=20s) is computed server-side from stored drawer_closed events rather than trusting a client-sent boolean - correct, since duration_seconds is computed from Date.now() deltas on the client and could theoretically be tampered with, but at least the threshold logic itself lives server-side.

ActivityListPage.jsx handleBookNow() and ActivityDetailPage.jsx trackAndOpenDrawer()/trackExternalClick() duplicate a fair amount of near-identical baseEvent-building + tracking logic across the two files - could be extracted into a shared helper in activityMarketplaceShared.js (e.g. buildBaseBookingEvent(activity, pageContext)) to reduce drift risk between the two pages, which is arguably how the DETAIL vs LIST page's generic-link handling ended up diverging into two different navigation patterns (see integration_issues).
No _id leakage, no hardcoded URLs, admin summary endpoint properly auth-gated via _require_admin_token - all consistent with existing module conventions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration focused only on the white/3-col ActivityListPage redesign + booking funnel tracking (per agent_to_agent_context_note), with light regression spot-checks of Charter Companies/Invoices/Dev Settings/Directory page (all still passing, consistent with iterations 91-93). One real reliability gap found: ActivityDetailPage's generic-external-link Book Now button loses its tracking events because it relies on native anchor target=_blank navigation with a non-awaited fire-and-forget POST, whereas ActivityListPage's identical scenario uses an explicit window.open() JS call that reliably lets the pending request complete first - recommend aligning both pages to the same pattern. Everything else (dropdown filters, card visuals matching the reference image exactly, FareHarbor drawer open/close/duration tracking on both list AND detail pages, admin Booking Activity widget with live-updating stats) verified working correctly with real click-throughs and backend confirmation via GET /api/tours-charters/booking-events/summary.
rca_of_the_issue: ActivityDetailPage.jsx renders the generic booking_url case as: `<a href={activity.booking_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" onClick={trackExternalClick}>`. trackExternalClick() calls trackBookingEvent() twice (book_now_click, external_redirect), each of which is `axios.post(...).catch(() => {})` - fired but never awaited, and the onClick handler doesn't call e.preventDefault(). The browser's default anchor-click behavior (opening href in a new tab per target=_blank) then proceeds essentially in parallel with those two outstanding network requests. In this test's Chromium automation context, the click was observed to navigate the CURRENT page instead of reliably spawning a new browsing context (page.context.pages stayed at length 1 across all 3 attempts, and page.url even appeared unchanged while page content visibly changed to FareHarbor's 404 page) - this unloads/replaces the document that initiated the pending fetches, causing the browser to abort them before they reach the server (confirmed via requestfinished/requestfailed listeners: 0 events of either kind were even raised, meaning the request was never dispatched over the network at all, most likely because Chromium's navigation-triggered document teardown happened within the same event-loop tick as the click handler, before axios could hand the request off to the network stack). Mitigation: change the DETAIL page to match the LIST page's pattern - call e.preventDefault() in the handler, fire trackBookingEvent() calls, then explicitly call window.open(activity.booking_url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') - this guarantees the current document is never replaced/unloaded, so the pending POSTs are never at risk of being aborted regardless of how the browser/environment handles target=_blank anchors.
